title: Review + merge PR #6 (Phase 4 M1 firmware)
description: Four post-review commits since the five-persona review: 7841db1 (loc_set/loc_clear + first DMA attempt), 00561c0 (README), e6b57ed (16KB LVGL stack), ff298ef (lvgl_port_add_disp rewiring — the real display fix, see docs/solutions/hardware-issues/waveshare-bsp-qspi-flush-ready-race.md), plus merge c877cd6. Live board verified on hardware by Mario. M2 (gc-74h) builds on this.

title: MTA Bus feed: API key custody + adapter (SOON per Mario)
description: Mario 2026-08-03: MTA Bus joins subway + Citi Bike for full NYC three-system coverage as a SOON step (supersedes the earlier 'Phase 6 territory' deferral in CLAUDE.md — update that line when this starts). Needs: MTA Bus Time API key custody (Worker secret, .env.example entry, prompt Mario for the real key — never invent/commit), bus GTFS-RT adapter behind the FeedAdapter seam, static bus GTFS ingest (big — route count is large), bus mode in /v1/nearby (direction_labels:null compass-tag question applies). Verify current MTA Bus API terms/endpoints before building.

title: Phase 5: accounts, pairing, config UI — headline: phone-supplied geolocation
description: Accounts, device tokens, pairing, config UI, retention purge (spec Phase 5). HEADLINE (Mario 2026-08-03): tethered phone supplies its GPS fix to the device — console loc_set is test-tooling only; phone geolocation is 'the only real viable solution' for locations where BeaconDB coverage is thin. Shape: phone<->device channel (BLE companion or pairing token + endpoint the phone posts location to). Surface as the first open question in ce-plan. Schema already has users/devices/favorites tables.

title: Phase 4 M2: touch, detail views, bike screen
description: Touch/gestures (FT3168), stop cycling, trunk detail view, bike screen — per docs/design/transit-watch-handoff.md. Data comes from /v1/nearby (already live); no new API dependencies. Include the font/polish pass: converted faces with tabular numerals at the handoff's true type ramp (14/15/16/17/18/20/24/25/27/30/36/40/84) replacing the even-size Montserrat mapping — Mario flagged current fonts feel small. Plan via ce-plan before building.

title: Bike coverage completeness check (NYC three-system goal)
description: Part of Mario's NYC coverage goal (subway + bus + bike). Server-side Citi Bike GBFS is live (stations, capacity, status with nullable counts). Verify: station status freshness, e-bike counts, anything /v1/nearby bike payload still lacks for the M2 bike screen (gc-74h). Device-side bike screen itself is in M2.

title: Install ingest cron on the opti box
description: Crontab line is in README ('Schedule it'). Daily static GTFS + catalog refresh. Locking makes overlapping runs safe.

title: Divergence #6 sign-off: nullable bike counts
description: From PR #3 era: when the GBFS status source is down, bikes_classic/bikes_electric/docks_open are null (capacity stays). Needs Mario's explicit sign-off; feeds into bike coverage quality.

title: Second-agency config-only acceptance test
description: The spec's acceptance test: a second (plain GTFS-RT) agency working with config changes only — no code. Proves the FeedAdapter seam. Good long-running opti task.

title: Check '0 min' countdowns + '0 ft' distance in live board
description: Live Borough Hall payload rendered all arrivals as '0 min' and distance '0 ft' (sim frame + device, 2026-08-03). 0 ft explained by loc_set coords sitting on the stop; 0 min may be legit at-platform trains or a flooring bug in the server-side m arrays. Verify eta math in nearby.ts before M2 builds detail views on it.

title: Phase 4 M3: IMU wake, deep sleep, power model
description: QMI8658 wake-on-motion, deep sleep between glances, PWR button, AXP2101 rail management — the guiding spec's power model. After M2.

title: BeaconDB coverage diagnostics walk
description: Field task with the device + phone using the DIAG_TOKEN-gated /v1/locate log+ref endpoints to measure BeaconDB accuracy around Mario's usual stations. Context: scan-based location 422s at Mario's home (thin coverage) — motivated loc_set and the Phase 5 phone-geolocation headline (gc-x8n).
